comments.body: Do you really choose a PhD candidate with a 4.0/4.0 GPA (undergrad, MSc) with 0 publications, with OK LoRs over a candidate with a 2.5/4.0 undergrad GPA and an OK MSc GPA but with 6-7 papers (mostly 1st author in Q1 journals) with sky-rocketed LoRs? I'm giving extreme cases to understand better.
comments.author: Dulduls
